'''{{ill|Kiyonoiba Shrine|ja|清野井庭神社|qid=Q17213398}}''' (*Kiyonoiba Jinja*) is an auxiliary shrine (*sessha*) of {{ill|Toyōke Daijingū|ja|豊受大神宮}} (the Outer Shrine of the [[Ise Grand Shrine]]), located in [[Ise]], {{ill|Mie Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Mie|af|Mie-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Mie|ar|ميه (محافظة)|ast|Prefeutura de Mie|az|Mie prefekturası|azb|میه اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Mié|be|Міэ|bg|Мие|bn|মিয়ে প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Mie|cdo|Mie-gâing|ce|Ми (префектура)|ceb|Mie-ken|ckb|پارێزگای میێ|cs|Prefektura Mie|cy|Mie (talaith)|da|Mie-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Mie|eo|Gubernio Mie|es|Prefectura de Mie|et|Mie prefektuur|eu|Mie (prefektura)|fa|استان میه|fi|Mien prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Mie|frr|Mie (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Mie|gl|Prefectura de Mie|hak|Mie-yen|he|מיאה (מחוז)|hi|मिऐ प्रीफेक्चर|hr|Mie (prefektura)|hu|Mie prefektúra|hy|Միե (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Mie|ilo|Prepektura ti Mie|it|Prefettura di Mie|ja|三重県|ka|მიეს პრეფექტურა|km|មីអិ(ខេត្ត)|ko|미에현|la|Mieensis|lt|Mijės prefektūra|lv|Mie prefektūra|mk|Мие (префектура)|mn|Миэ муж|mni|ꯃꯤꯏ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|मिई प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Mie|ne|मिए|nl|Mie (prefectuur)|no|Mie (prefektur)|nov|Mie Prefekture|os|Миэ|pam|Prepektura ning Mie|pl|Prefektura Mie|pnb|ضلع مائی|pt|Mie|ro|Prefectura Mie|ru|Миэ|se|Mie prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Mie|si|මියේ ප්‍රාන්තය|simple|Mie Prefecture|sk|Mie (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Мије|su|Préféktur Mie|sv|Mie prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Mie|tg|Префектураи Мие|th|จังหวัดมิเอะ|tl|Prepektura ng Mie|tr|Mie|tt|Ми (префектура)|uk|Префектура Міє|ur|میہ پریفیکچر|vi|Mie|war|Mie (prefektura)|wuu|三重县|zh|三重县|zh_classical|三重縣|zh_min_nan|Mie-koān|zh_yue|三重縣|qid=Q128196|lt=Mie Prefecture}}, Japan. It Ranks 9th among the auxiliary shrines of the Outer Shrine.<ref name="uy">Ujiyamada City Office (1929): Volume 1, p. 12.</ref>

== Overview ==
{{ill|Mie Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Mie|af|Mie-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Mie|ar|ميه (محافظة)|ast|Prefeutura de Mie|az|Mie prefekturası|azb|میه اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Mié|be|Міэ|bg|Мие|bn|মিয়ে প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Mie|cdo|Mie-gâing|ce|Ми (префектура)|ceb|Mie-ken|ckb|پارێزگای میێ|cs|Prefektura Mie|cy|Mie (talaith)|da|Mie-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Mie|eo|Gubernio Mie|es|Prefectura de Mie|et|Mie prefektuur|eu|Mie (prefektura)|fa|استان میه|fi|Mien prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Mie|frr|Mie (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Mie|gl|Prefectura de Mie|hak|Mie-yen|he|מיאה (מחוז)|hi|मिऐ प्रीफेक्चर|hr|Mie (prefektura)|hu|Mie prefektúra|hy|Միե (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Mie|ilo|Prepektura ti Mie|it|Prefettura di Mie|ja|三重県|ka|მიეს პრეფექტურა|km|មីអិ(ខេត្ត)|ko|미에현|la|Mieensis|lt|Mijės prefektūra|lv|Mie prefektūra|mk|Мие (префектура)|mn|Миэ муж|mni|ꯃꯤꯏ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|मिई प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Mie|ne|मिए|nl|Mie (prefectuur)|no|Mie (prefektur)|nov|Mie Prefekture|os|Миэ|pam|Prepektura ning Mie|pl|Prefektura Mie|pnb|ضلع مائی|pt|Mie|ro|Prefectura Mie|ru|Миэ|se|Mie prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Mie|si|මියේ ප්‍රාන්තය|simple|Mie Prefecture|sk|Mie (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Мије|su|Préféktur Mie|sv|Mie prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Mie|tg|Префектураи Мие|th|จังหวัดมิเอะ|tl|Prepektura ng Mie|tr|Mie|tt|Ми (префектура)|uk|Префектура Міє|ur|میہ پریفیکچر|vi|Mie|war|Mie (prefektura)|wuu|三重县|zh|三重县|zh_classical|三重縣|zh_min_nan|Mie-koān|zh_yue|三重縣|qid=Q128196|lt=Mie Prefecture}}{{ill|Ise, Mie|en|Ise, Mie|qid=Q328067|lt=Ise City}} Tokiwa 1-chome, 1197 <ref name="sk9">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p. 329</ref> (in the residential address system: Tokiwa 1-chome, 8) is where the shrine is located. There is a theory that the former shrine site was at the {{ill|Ise Takayanagi Shopping Street|ja|伊勢高柳商店街|qid=Q11379159}} in Miyamachi 1-chome, Ise City <ref name="sk9"/>. If this theory is correct, it would suggest a different position for {{ill|Kusanagi Shrine (Ise)|ja|草奈伎神社|qid=Q17228323}} and {{ill|Kusanagi Shrine (Ise)|ja|草奈伎神社|qid=Q17228323}} as described in "Ruiju Jingihongen" <ref name="sk0">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p. 330</ref>. The "Ujiyamada City History" suggests that the original Oma Kokuso Shrine had a larger precinct and that Kiyonoiba Shrine was established on the current site based on the situation during its reconstruction <ref>Ujiyamada City Office (1929): pp. 936-937</ref>. The shrine grounds are rectangular, with an area of 1,095 square meters <ref name="sk3">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p. 333</ref>.

The {{ill|Saijin|ja|Kami|lt=Deity}} is {{ill|Kaya-no-hime|es|Kaya-no-hime|fa|کایا-نو-هیمه|it|Kaya-no-hime|ja|カヤノヒメ|zh|鹿屋野比賣神|qid=Q8191878|lt=Kayanohime}} <ref name="uy"/> (Kayanohime no Mikoto <ref name="ic2">Ise Bunka-sha (2008): p. 52</ref>). The deity is associated with the {{ill|irrigation canal|ay|Larqa|ca|Canal de reg|cs|Zavlažovací kanál|eo|Irigacia kanalo|es|Canal de riego|fr|Canal d'irrigation|he|תעלת השקיה|ht|Kanal irigasyon|it|Roggia|ja|用水路|lmo|Ronsgia|mg|Lakandrano|qu|Rarqa|qid=Q2935978}} near the shrine, though another theory suggests it is a {{ill|Bunrei|en|Bunrei|qid=Q195793|lt=spirit}} of the deity of shipbuilding <ref>Ise Bunka-sha (2008): pp. 52-53</ref>. "Jinmyocho Kosho Saiko" states that the enshrined deity is the same as {{ill|Shitomi Shrine|ja|志等美神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shitomi Shrine}}.

The {{ill|Torii|en|Torii|qid=Q234731|lt=torii}} faces east, and the {{ill|Shinto architecture|ja|社殿|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/shrine building|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 神社建築|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q3080012}} is located immediately to the right after entering <ref name="sk4">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p. 334</ref>. Built in {{ill|Shinmei-zukuri|en|Shinmei-zukuri|qid=Q930545|lt=Shimmei-zukuri}} style with wooden planks, it is surrounded by a {{ill|Sacred fences|en|Tamagaki|qid=Q3078312|lt=Tamagaki}} <ref name="sk4"/>. There is no offering box.

== History ==
[[File:Kiyonoibajinja sengu.jpg|thumb|220px|right|Scene from the reconstruction on October 11, 2017.]]

name="sk9"/>.

The shrine was established before the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳}}, meaning it predates 927. It also appears in the "Toyukemiya Gishikicho" <ref name="sk1">Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p. 331</ref>, indicating its existence before 804. Rituals ceased by the late {{ill|Middle Ages|en|Middle Ages|qid=Q12554|lt=medieval period}}, and the site was forgotten until {{ill|Gūji|ja|大宮司|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oomiya-ji|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 宮司|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11453500}} {{ill|Kiyonaga Kawabe|ja|河辺精長|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kawabe Masanaga|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q92924151}} restored it on June 21, 1663 (Gregorian calendar: July 25, 1663) <ref>Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): pp. 329-332</ref>.

During {{ill|World War II|en|World War II|qid=Q362|lt=World War II}}, the shrine was damaged in the {{ill|Ujiyamada Air Raid|ja|宇治山田空襲}} on July 29, 1945 <ref>Ise City (1968): p. 445</ref>. Postwar {{ill|land readjustment|ja|区画整理|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/land readjustment|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 土地区画整理事業|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11423116}} reduced the northern area and expanded the western part <ref name="sk3"/>.

The shrine was rebuilt on May 10, 1980 <ref name="sk4"/> and again on October 11, 2017.

== Rituals ==
{{ill|Kinensai|en|Kinen-sai|qid=Q118906710|lt=Kinen-sai}} (February), {{ill|Tsukinami-sai|ja|月次祭}} (June, December), {{ill|Kannamesai Festival|en|Kannamesai Festival|qid=Q11255045|lt=Kannamesai}} (October), and {{ill|Niiname-no-Matsuri|de|Niiname-sai|fr|Niiname-no-Matsuri|id|Niiname-no-Matsuri|ja|新嘗祭|ko|신상제 (11월)|simple|Niiname-no-Matsuri|qid=Q11501518|lt=Niinamesai}} (November) are conducted by a {{ill|Negi|ja|禰宜|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/negi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11594490}} at the shrine. {{ill|Saitan-sai|ja|歳旦祭}} (January 1), {{ill|Genshi-sai|ja|元始祭}} (January 3), {{ill|National Foundation Day|ja|建国記念祭}} (February 11), {{ill|The Emperor's Birthday|ja|天長祭|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenchō-sai|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 天皇誕生日|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q72318}} (February 23), and {{ill|Kazahi-no-Misai|ja|風日祈祭|2=ja|3=風日祈祭|qid=Q135524493|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaze-no-hi-ki-sai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135524493}} (May, August) are held remotely <ref>Shikinaisha Research Association (1990): p. 332</ref>.

== Flora ==
The precinct has tall trees such as {{ill|Celtis sinensis|en|Celtis sinensis|qid=Q706339|lt=enoki}} and {{ill|Camphora officinarum|en|Camphora officinarum|qid=Q158722|lt=camphor trees}}, along with mid-sized trees like {{ill|Quercus glauca|en|Quercus glauca|qid=Q714124|lt=arakashi}} and {{ill|Zelkova serrata|en|Zelkova serrata|qid=Q920344|lt=zelkova}} <ref name="sk3"/>. Newly added western areas have {{ill|Viburnum odoratissimum|en|Viburnum odoratissimum|qid=Q12600081|lt=coral trees}} <ref name="sk3"/>.

== Access ==
; Public Transportation
* {{ill|Central Japan Railway Company|en|Central Japan Railway Company|qid=Q513679|lt=JR Central}} {{ill|Sangū Line|en|Sangū Line|qid=Q872023|lt=Sangu Line}}: About 300m southeast of {{ill|Yamada-Kamiguchi Station|en|Yamada-Kamiguchi Station|qid=Q93446|lt=Yamada-Kamiguchi Station}} <ref name="sk9"/>.
